intro.title: Tiger Eye Shree Yantra
intro.descriptionHtml: Explore our Premium Collection of 3D Meru Tiger Eye Shree Yantras, crafted from Natural, Unheated Tiger Eye. Each handmade Sri Chakra Yantra is carved from a single stone, featuring Accurate Sacred Geometry, Intricate Detailing & Exceptional Craftsmanship, in different sizes and designs. Made from premium-grade Tiger Eye with golden-brown bands and a natural silky lustre, each piece reflects superior quality and precision. Ideal for strengthening courage, sharpening focus, and building discipline, while inviting protection, resilience, and abundance into your space.
